components.css: .ds-code-editor{overflow:hidden;border-radius:14px;background:#fff;color:#1b2333;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(20,30,60,.05),0 8px 24px rgba(20,30,60,.06)}.ds-code-editor header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:10px 13px;border-bottom:1px solid #e3e8f2}.ds-code-editor header>div:first-child{display:flex;flex-direction:column}.ds-code-editor header strong{font-size:13px}.ds-code-editor header span{font-size:11px;color:#7b869c}.ds-code-editor header>div:last-child{display:flex;gap:7px}.ds-code-editor button{border:1px solid #e3e8f2;border-radius:9px;padding:7px 11px;background:#f5f7fb;color:#1b2333;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}.ds-code-editor button:hover,.ds-code-editor button:focus-visible{border-color:#2f6bff;outline:0;color:#2f6bff}.ds-code-stage{min-height:180px;padding:12px 0;font:13.5px/1.65 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,monospace}.ds-code-stage>span{display:grid;grid-template-columns:38px minmax(max-content,1fr)}.ds-code-stage i{padding-right:12px;text-align:right;color:#98a3b7;font-style:normal}.ds-code-stage code{font:inherit}.ds-code-stage b{color:#7c3aed}.ds-code-stage em{color:#2f6bff;font-style:normal}.ds-code-editor footer{min-height:38px;padding:9px 13px;border-top:1px solid #e3e8f2;background:#f5f7fb;color:#7b869c;font-size:12px;font-weight:650}

narrative.overview: A compact operational workspace that keeps lesson stage, task, live student work, validation and group state visible as one connected field. Calm technical surfaces and disciplined semantic color support rapid scanning during a live lesson.
keyCharacteristics: Monospace for code and numeric work
Tonal depth with quiet borders and shadows

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Blue means action or live selection; green, amber and red retain their state meanings.

rules.name: The Scan Before Read Rule
rules.body: Expose state through hierarchy before adding explanatory prose.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: Use tonal surfaces and borders before visible lift.

rules.name: The Statistics Truth Rule
rules.body: Tutor coaching, local Run, hints and laser gestures never change active time, tries or correctness.

dos: Do keep lesson state, task context and live work spatially connected.
Do pair status color with text, symbol or value.
Do preserve light and dark semantic contrast.
Do place the expanded task prompt above each full-size editing context.
Do derive individual, group and student content from the lesson DTO and role-filtered attempt data.
donts: Don't use semantic colors as arbitrary decoration.
Don't introduce oversized editorial type into the live lesson.
Don't expose tutor-only Laser or contextual coaching controls to students.
Don't let coaching mutate attempt fields other than code.
Don't let tutor coaching, local Run, hints or laser affect active time, tries or correctness.
Don't persist targeted laser trails or hints as attempt statistics.
Don't canonize demo names, dates, timers, counts or KPI values.
